nvitk.measure.morpho.preprocess_taubin
======================================

.. py:module:: nvitk.measure.morpho.preprocess_taubin

.. autoapi-nested-parse::

   Taubin smoothing of multi-label segmentations.

   All processing functions are importable; edit the CONFIG block below only for
   direct single-case runs.

----------

   nvitk.measure.morpho.preprocess_taubin.TAUBIN_MU

Module Contents
---------------

.. py:data:: INPUT_PATH
   :value: None


.. py:data:: OUTPUT_DIR
   :value: None


.. py:data:: OUTPUT_NAME
   :value: None


.. py:data:: KEEP_LARGEST_COMPONENT
   :value: False


.. py:data:: TAUBIN_ITERS
   :value: 20


.. py:data:: TAUBIN_LAMBDA
   :value: 0.65


.. py:data:: TAUBIN_MU
   :value: -0.65


.. py:function:: ensure_dir(path: str) -> None

   Create *path* (and parents) if missing; no-op otherwise.


.. py:function:: load_segmentation(path: str)

   Load a NIfTI label volume; returns ``(int32 data, affine, header)``.


.. py:function:: save_segmentation(path: str, data: numpy.ndarray, affine, header) -> None

   Write *data* as an int16 NIfTI label volume, reusing *affine*/*header*.


.. py:function:: keep_largest_component(mask: numpy.ndarray) -> numpy.ndarray

   Boolean mask of only the largest 26-connected component of *mask*.


.. py:function:: signed_distance(mask: numpy.ndarray) -> numpy.ndarray

   Signed Euclidean distance field: negative inside *mask*, positive outside.


.. py:function:: crop_with_padding(mask: numpy.ndarray, pad: int) -> Tuple[numpy.ndarray, Tuple[slice, slice, slice]]

   Tight bounding-box crop of *mask* with *pad* voxels of margin; returns ``(cropped, bbox_slices)``.


.. py:function:: _laplacian(field: numpy.ndarray) -> numpy.ndarray

   Discrete Laplacian of an n-d field (sum of second differences along each axis, normalized).


.. py:function:: taubin_smooth_field(field: numpy.ndarray, iterations: int, lam: float, mu: float) -> numpy.ndarray

   Taubin (λ/μ) smoothing of a scalar field: alternating Laplacian steps that resist shrinkage.


.. py:function:: build_taubin_scores(seg: numpy.ndarray, labels: Iterable[int], keep_largest: bool, taubin_iters: int, taubin_lambda: float, taubin_mu: float, skip_smoothing: Iterable[int] = ()) -> Dict[int, numpy.ndarray]

   Per-label Taubin-smoothed signed-distance score map (cropped, then padded back to full shape).

   Each label's SDF is used as a competing "fitness" score for :func:`fuse_from_scores`.
   Labels in *skip_smoothing* keep their raw (unsmoothed) SDF.


.. py:function:: fuse_from_scores(score_maps: Dict[int, numpy.ndarray], shape: Tuple[int, int, int]) -> numpy.ndarray

   Re-fuse per-label score maps into one label volume: argmax label wins, 0 where all scores ≤ 0.


.. py:function:: preprocess_segmentation(seg: numpy.ndarray, keep_largest: bool, taubin_iters: int, taubin_lambda: float, taubin_mu: float, skip_smoothing: Iterable[int] = (17, 18)) -> numpy.ndarray

   Full Taubin-smoothing pipeline: score each label, then fuse back to one label volume.


.. py:function:: main() -> None

   Direct-run entry point: smooth ``INPUT_PATH`` per the CONFIG block and write output + JSON report.
